activeEvents.type: The treasury walls bleed molten gold that forms screaming faces before solidifying into runes. Massive chains of shadow and bone erupt from the ground, binding the city's towers together. The sky above the vaults turns a bruised purple, and the sound of counting coins echoes like thunder from the depths.
activeEvents.description: The Gilded Resonance of the Soul-Vaults: After 35,250 days, the accumulated wealth of your civilization has coalesced into a semi-sentient entity known as the Aureate Maw. The treasury no longer holds mere coin; it pulses with the stolen life-force of eons. The Maw demands sustenance or it will consume the living. The Arcane Cabal must perform the Rite of Blood-Ledger, sacrificing a portion of the hoard to the Abyssal Markets to keep the entity sated and unlock its forbidden transmutation secrets.
